subject: Welcome Aboard — Let's Get You Started
preheader: We are genuinely glad you are here. Over the next few minutes you will connect your workspace, invite teammates, and turn on the one automation that saves the most time—small steps, clear guidance, and help if you ever get stuck.

content.headline: Welcome aboard
content.subheadline: You are all set—let’s personalize your workspace, invite your team, and ship something small today. We will walk you through it at your pace.
content.imagePrompt: Warm welcoming workspace scene, morning light through sheer curtains, plant on desk, laptop open with soft blur, cozy editorial photography, earth tones

items.heading: Connect your tools
items.description: Link email, calendar, and your repo—imports run in the background so you can keep exploring.

items.heading: Invite your team
items.description: Send invites with suggested roles; they will land in a guided first-run that matches yours.

items.heading: Turn on smart defaults
items.description: Enable the weekly summary and one automation—we picked the ones new teams enable most.

content.headline: Ready when you are
content.description: Jump into the in-app checklist anytime—it saves your progress automatically.

content.unsubscribeText: Onboarding tips are sent to help you succeed. You can turn off product tips in Settings → Notifications.
